about.title: About Innstate
about.intro: Innstate is a travel deals platform connecting travelers with exclusive hotel offers worldwide.
about.p1: Innstate is a discovery platform for hotel deals — a place where travelers can explore exclusive offers from hotels around the world and easily request more information.
about.p2: We curate hotel deals across major destinations, making it simple to browse offers, compare options, and submit an inquiry — all without the complexity of a booking system.
about.p3: Our focus is simple: help you discover better hotel deals, faster. No clutter, no pressure — just great offers worth exploring.
about.p4: From Dubai to Paris, Bangkok to the Maldives, our growing list of destinations spans the globe so you can dream — and plan — without limits.
about.p5: Every inquiry matters. We aim to respond quickly and help you find a hotel deal that fits your trip.
